payload.text: **THE APP DISTINGUISHES THREE ENDPOINT STATES -- LIVE, STALE, ABSENT -- AND NEVER RENDERS `RUNNING` FOR AN ENDPOINT THAT CONNECTS WITHOUT ANSWERING.** **THIS ROW READ `the same three endpoint states THE ROUTING RULE DOES` UNTIL 2026-08-31, ASSERTING A PREMISE `Route` EXPLICITLY REFUSES:** its own doc states the absence of a third variant as the invariant -- *it holds because this type cannot express it and `route` is total*, and a `Both` arm or an ignorable `Option<Endpoint>` would move the guarantee out of the type system and into everyone's discipline. **The three states are therefore a PROJECTION ABOVE `route()`, never a widening of it**, which is also what keeps `AC-01.2` true by construction: app -> CLI verb -> projection -> `route()`, one predicate and one code path. (Found by cc, 2026-08-31, by reading this row against the type it names; repaired by vc under the standing pen. The premise was false when written, so this is a row stating something the artefact refuses -- not a reword to match an unfinished build.) `AC-08.3` names both false positives and this row inherits both: **a dead daemon leaves its socket file behind**, and **an inherited listening descriptor accepts connections nothing will ever answer** (no atomic `SOCK_CLOEXEC` on macOS; measured by cc 2026-08-29 at 1 in 300 with a sibling thread spawning children, 0 in 2000 without). **The app is where these are most damaging, because it is the surface an operator consults INSTEAD of measuring**, so a green dot is trusted in a way a CLI exit code is not. **Both states are constructed in the check, never waited for** -- a suite that passes because a 1-in-300 race did not fire has measured nothing. **AND THE SPLIT BETWEEN THE TWO NON-LIVE STATES MUST BE OBSERVABLE IN THE REMEDY, WITH THE INHERITED-DESCRIPTOR CASE LANDING ON `ABSENT`.** The prohibition above is satisfied by EITHER candidate discriminator -- the kernel lock and a bare `connect()` both render not-RUNNING for both false positives -- so **this criterion does not force the row, and a build must not be read as compliant merely because its vocabulary matches this sentence.** What it must show is that STALE and ABSENT carry DIFFERENT remedies: STALE means a holder is alive and not serving, so the operator investigates it and must NOT unlink (`AC-08.12`, where being wrong is destructive), while ABSENT means nothing owns the endpoint and residue is safe to clear. An orphaned listening descriptor has no holder to investigate, so a build rendering it STALE fails this row by declaring a remedy it cannot carry out. (vc ruling, 2026-08-31, on cc's six-case measurement; the discriminator itself lives beside the projection in `intentsvcs::daemon` and is not restated here.)
